_doc: Map marks (Update 04 section 3, DECISIONS T-069): limits, lifetimes, colours, the in-world markers and the note presets. Read by core/map/map_marks.gd (MapMarks), core/map/world_marks.gd (WorldMarks), the pause map (gravelight/ui/pause_map_view.gd) and the ping key (gravelight/ui/mark_ping.gd). What bots do with marks is in data/gravelight/ai/marks.json.

limits._doc: personal: your own waypoints (go, note, buy-for-yourself), the oldest goes when a new one would pass the cap. danger: danger marks per player. regroup: one regroup mark at a time. Orders: one per bot (a new one replaces it).

lifetime_s._doc: Marks that end by themselves (0 = until removed). Orders end when the bot is done or gives up (the bots' marks.json).

ping._doc: The ping key (GRAVELIGHT ping: middle mouse / D-pad up; B&S bs_ping: G / Back). range_m: how far it reaches; double_tap_s: a second press this fast makes a Danger mark; confirm_s: a second press on a door within this confirms 'open this door'; remove_m: pinging within this of one of your marks removes it.

world._doc: In-world markers: GRAVELIGHT a chalk X on the floor, B&S a holo pin; a label (icon + distance) above each. fade_begin_m..hide_m: the label fades out; labels_max: only the nearest few carry a label; near_hide_m: standing on it hides the label. T-247: label_alpha caps the label, it fades out over near_fade_m past near_hide_m and to center_alpha within center_fade_px (at 1080p) of the screen centre; label_font_px its size.
